en.headline: Over 300 join counter-terrorism drill at AsiaWorld-Expo
en.dek: New Territories South police led a multi-agency exercise simulating security threats and attacks during a mock international sports conference later this year.
body: More than 300 personnel from multiple government departments and organisations completed a joint counter-terrorism drill at AsiaWorld-Expo on Tuesday, in preparation for a major international sports conference scheduled for later this year.

The exercise was led by the New Territories South Regional Headquarters of the Hong Kong Police Force and organised with the Sports Federation and Olympic Committee of Hong Kong, China, the Fire Services Department, AsiaWorld-Expo and the Hong Kong Association for Conflict and Catastrophe Medicine.

The drill simulated security threats and terrorist attacks during a mock summit. Specialised police units, including the Emergency Unit, Police Tactical Unit, Airport District, Counter Terrorism Response Unit, Cyber Security and Technology Crime Bureau, VIP Protection Unit and Explosive Ordnance Disposal Bureau, coordinated evacuations, tactical containment and emergency rescues with partner agencies.

Responders used the internal software platform “iCasualty” for real-time inter-departmental communication, allowing faster identification of casualties and tracking of medical status. Police said the exercise would help refine contingency plans to ensure public safety and the smooth running of the forthcoming conference.

zh.headline: 亞博館逾300人參與跨部門反恐演習
zh.dek: 新界南總區聯同港協暨奧委會、消防處等舉行「勇箭」演習，模擬年底國際體育會議期間遇恐襲，測試協調應變。
body: 警方新界南總區周二聯同中國香港體育協會暨奧林匹克委員會、消防處、亞洲國際博覽館及香港危難應變醫學會，在亞博館舉行跨部門反恐演習，超過300人參與，為年底舉行的國際體育會議作準備。
演習代號「勇箭」，模擬國際體育會議進行期間發生涉及國家安全、影響大會有序進行的事件及恐怖襲擊。新界南總區衝鋒隊、警察機動部隊、機場警區、反恐特勤隊、網絡安全及科技罪案調查科、要員保護組、爆炸品處理課等單位與相關持份者協作，進行緊急救援、疏散、事故處理及善後支援。
人員運用內部軟件「iCasualty」作跨部門資訊溝通，更快識別傷者身份及掌握最新情況，提升調查及處理查詢效率。
警方表示會繼續與各持份者保持緊密聯繫，檢視相關應變計劃，為即將舉行的國際體育會議作全面準備，確保公共安全及會議順利進行。
